settings_language_description: Choose the language used across the app and by the AI assistant.
settings_password_description: Change the password used to sign in. This will sign you out on all other devices.
settings_json_import_export_description: Show the options to import a recipe from JSON-LD and to export a recipe as JSON in the app's menus.
settings_family_description: Everyone in your family shares one recipe collection — all recipes, tags and categories are visible to every member, and any member can edit them.
settings_family_invite_hint: Anyone who opens this link and signs in joins your family. Only share it with your household.
settings_family_leave_dialog_description: The shared recipes stay with the family — you will start again with an empty collection of your own.
settings_danger_zone_description: Permanently delete your account and your settings. Recipes, tags and categories your family shares stay with the family; if you are its only member, they are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
settings_ai_usage_description: The AI assistant runs on a budget shared by everyone on this server. A day's share is added every day, and whatever goes unused carries over until the month ends.
auth_forgot_password_check_email_body: If that email is registered, we've sent a link to reset your password.
auth_reset_password_invalid_link_body: This reset link is missing its token. Request a new one.
recipes_list_empty: No recipes yet. Try importing or adding one.
recipes_share_description: Anyone with the link can view this recipe, no account needed. People with a Yumbry account can save their own copy.
recipes_share_hint: Copies are independent: edits to this recipe don't reach them, and theirs don't reach you.
recipes_share_stop_dialog_description: The link stops working right away. Copies people already saved stay theirs. Sharing again creates a new link.
recipe_versions_empty: No earlier versions yet — a version is saved each time you edit this recipe.
recipe_versions_reverted_toast: Recipe reverted to the selected version
recipe_form_details_description: The basics — title, description, and photo.
recipe_form_timing_description: How long this takes to make, and how many it serves.
recipe_form_category_tags_description: Help this recipe surface in search and filters.
recipe_form_reviewing_url_draft: Reviewing a recipe imported from a URL — check it carefully before saving.
recipe_form_reviewing_ai_draft: Reviewing an AI-generated draft — check it carefully before saving.
recipe_form_add_tag_placeholder: Add a tag and press Enter
recipe_form_nutrition_description: Values are for a single serving.
recipe_form_reviewing_photo_draft: Reviewing a recipe read from a photo — check the amounts carefully before saving.
import_json_card_description: Copy the recipe's structured data and paste it below.
import_url_card_description: Point Yumbry at a recipe page and review a draft before saving it.
import_photo_card_description: A handwritten card, a cookbook page, a screenshot — Yumbry will draft the recipe for you.
import_photo_hint: Works best with a clear, well-lit shot of the full recipe.
ai_chat_improve_example: e.g. "make it spicier" or "swap the chicken for tofu".
ai_chat_create_example: e.g. "a spicy vegetarian curry, serves 4" — say as much or as little as you like.
ai_chat_change_placeholder: Tell the AI what to change
ai_chat_cook_placeholder: Tell the AI what you'd like to cook
ai_chat_units_description: Choose the units the AI assistant writes new recipes in. Recipes you have already saved are never converted.
ai_chat_small_volumes_description: How the AI assistant writes small amounts in metric recipes. Millilitres are exact; spoon measures are quicker to reach for. Has no effect on imperial recipes.
reorder_drag_started: Picked up item {position} of {total} in {list}. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space, Enter or Escape to drop it.
reorder_instructions: Tab to a handle and press Space or Enter to start moving it.
photo_error_too_large: That photo is too large. Please use one under {limitMb} MB.
photo_error_unreadable_image: That photo could not be read. Try a JPEG or PNG.
recipe_preview_empty: Your recipe will appear here once you start chatting.
join_family_description: You've been invited to share a recipe collection. Your own recipes, tags and categories come with you and are merged into the family's collection.
shared_recipe_save_copy: Like this recipe? Save your own copy to your recipes. You can change it without affecting the original.
shared_recipe_already_yours: This recipe is already in your collection.
shared_recipe_sign_up_prompt: Want to keep this recipe? Create a free account to save it to your own collection.
shared_recipe_unavailable_title: This link is no longer active
shared_recipe_unavailable_description: The owner may have stopped sharing this recipe, or the link is incomplete.
onboarding_language_description: Let's set a few things up. First, choose your language.
onboarding_create_description: Pick whichever fits — you can mix and match any time.
onboarding_create_hint: Find "Add recipe" in the top right of any page. It opens straight into whichever way you'd like to start.
onboarding_create_manual_description: Type up ingredients and steps yourself, from scratch.
onboarding_create_url_description: Paste a link and Yumbry pulls in the recipe for you.
onboarding_create_photo_description: Snap or upload a photo and AI reads out the recipe.
onboarding_create_ai_description: Describe a dish and let AI draft the recipe.
onboarding_family_description: When you join a family, everyone's recipes come together into one shared collection.
onboarding_family_hint: You can create or join a family any time from Settings.
onboarding_pwa_title: Add Yumbry to your home screen
onboarding_pwa_description: Install Yumbry like an app so it's one tap away.
onboarding_pwa_steps_ios_safari_1: Tap the Share icon in Safari's toolbar.
onboarding_pwa_steps_ios_safari_2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
onboarding_pwa_steps_ios_other_1: Open this page in Safari — other iOS browsers can't install apps to the home screen.
onboarding_pwa_steps_android_other_1: Look for "Install app" or "Add to Home screen" in your browser's menu.
onboarding_pwa_steps_desktop_1: Look for an install icon in the address bar (or the browser menu).
onboarding_pwa_steps_desktop_2: Click "Install" to add Yumbry as an app on this device.
onboarding_done_description: Your kitchen is ready. Start by adding your first recipe.
not_found_description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or may have been moved.
ai_quota_shared_exceeded: The shared AI budget is used up for now. Please try again later.
ai_quota_shared_exceeded_at: The shared AI budget is used up for now. Try again after {time}.
ai_quota_user_exceeded: You've used up your AI allowance for today.
ai_quota_user_exceeded_at: You've used up your AI allowance for today. Try again after {time}.
server_unavailable_description: Yumbry is currently unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
server_unavailable_hint: Your recipes are safe. Try again in a moment.
